description: From the square, Ringkøbing Church is red brick, with a west tower that spreads wider at the top, four triangular gables, and a low pyramidal roof, plus a side wing. The square is empty. The night is mainly clear, about 12.6°C. Moonlight reaches the ground under a thin cloud cover. The fjord basin is not in this frame.
